name: abstractwiki_render_status
comment: Render status of each stored Abstract Wikipedia article section, per language. One row per (topic, language, section), holding the current state only. Lives on the shared x1 cluster via the 'virtual-abstractwiki' virtual domain.

columns.name: awr_topic
columns.comment: The Wikidata item ID of the abstract article (e.g. 'Q90')

columns.name: awr_section
columns.comment: The Wikidata item ID of the section (e.g. 'Q8776414')

columns.name: awr_lang
columns.comment: The BCP-47 code of the language the section was rendered in

columns.name: awr_fragments
columns.comment: Total number of fragments in the section

columns.name: awr_pending
columns.comment: Number of fragments shown as pending

columns.name: awr_failed
columns.comment: Number of fragments shown as an error

columns.name: awr_rendered
columns.comment: When the stored section was rendered
